about_the_game:
Take care of your desktop garden while you work, study, or relax!
My Tiny Garden is a cozy game that runs at the bottom of your screen, turning your desktop into a comfortable little world of plants.

Decorate your screen, customize your garden, and build the calmest corner of your digital life.
My Tiny Garden is the perfect relaxing companion for your daily routine.

  • 🌱 Take care of your plants: Water, trim, and add compost to keep them happy and healthy.

  • 💰 Earn coins: Well-cared-for plants will reward you with coins.

  • 🌼 Unlock new content: Use coins to buy new types of plants, pots, and stands.

  • 🎀 Customize your garden: Add cute decorations to make your garden unique and cozy.

  • 🖥️ Decorate your desktop: Freely move your plants around and create a charming environment while you use your computer.

  • 🌸 Calm and relaxing atmosphere: Perfect for keeping things peaceful while you work or study.

For streamers, influencers, or anyone who wants to share their little plants with the world — when you go live on Twitch, your followers can appear in your game as cute little butterflies! They can join your garden and make it even more magical.
